title: Mirabel and the Horizon
author: Oscar Okafor
blurb: Beatrix Fairweather, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
